newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 2c to 618c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 2c to 618c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell two cents to 618 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Adelaide, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mostly cheaper, with 19/21/22/23 microns 0.5 percent cheaper, 20/24m unchanged, 25m up to one percent dearer and 26m 0.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings of 19m were generally unchanged and 20/21m slightly cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27/29m were slightly dearer, 28/31m 0.5 percent cheaper and 30m 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, locks one percent dearer and crutchings slightly dearer.
WI said Japanese interests and China were principal buyers with good support from local mills and Taiwan.
Of the 22,301 bales offered, 7.3 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney and Adelaide with about 22,700 bales to be offered.
